audience: hotels, inns and rental properties that manage bookings in ThinkReservations

useCases.title: See which guests arrive next week
useCases.text: List the reservations with a stay date in a date range. Add the guest contact details if the API key has the customer scope.

useCases.title: Check open units by room type for a month
useCases.text: Read the daily inventory per room type for a date range. List the room types first to get their ids. Use the numbers to plan sales.

useCases.title: Quote a stay with fees, taxes and deposit
useCases.text: Search what the property can sell for given dates and guests. Read the price per rate type with fees, taxes, deposit and total. The quote books nothing.

useCases.title: Review rates, restrictions and promotions
useCases.text: Read the day-by-day price, minimum stay and closed-to-arrival rules of a rate type. Compare them with the active promotions of the property.

useCases.title: Sync changed reservations to a spreadsheet
useCases.text: List the reservations that changed since a given time. Use the result to update a report or sheet without a full export.

useCases.title: Find blocked dates for single rooms
useCases.text: List the blackouts in a date range. See which rooms are blocked on which dates before you promise a room to a guest.
